name: Nickel PPS dose trial
question: Does pentosan polysulfate sodium at 100 mg once or three times daily improve IC/BPS symptoms more than placebo?

arms.label: Pentosan polysulfate sodium 100 mg once daily
pentosan polysulfate sodium 100 mg three times daily

design.population: 369 adults randomized (368 treated in the ITT set) with IC/BPS symptoms for at least 6 months, ICSI total score at least 8 and a positive score on each item, at least 10 daily voids including nocturia, without cystoscopic eligibility criteria.
design.locator: Full text, Patients and Study Design, p 858; Results and Figure 1, p 859

verdictNote: Neither active dose improved the primary symptom responder endpoint over placebo.
takeaway: In adults with IC/BPS symptoms, pentosan polysulfate sodium 100 mg once or three times daily did not show superior study-end ICSI responder rates versus placebo in a treated ITT analysis with last observation carried forward; the trial stopped early for futility.

reports.label: Primary report
reports.citation: Nickel JC, Herschorn S, Whitmore KE, et al. "Pentosan polysulfate sodium for treatment of interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome: insights from a randomized, double-blind, placebo controlled study." *J Urol.* 2015;193(3):857-862. doi:10.1016/j.juro.2014.09.036
reports.followUpLocator: Full text, Study Design and Efficacy Assessments, p 858

results.measure: At least 30% reduction from baseline ICSI total score at final evaluation through week 24 (ITT, last observation carried forward for withdrawals)
results.note: The first sequential hypothesis, PPS 100 mg three times daily versus placebo, crossed the prespecified interim futility boundary (P ≥ 0.08); the paper gives no exact pairwise P values, effect estimates or confidence intervals.
results.locator: Full text, Data Analysis, p 859; Efficacy and Table, p 860

results.measure: GRA, moderately or markedly improved at study end (ITT)
results.note: No statistically significant between-group difference for any secondary endpoint; pairwise effect estimates, confidence intervals and P values were not reported for this measure.
results.locator: Full text, Efficacy End Points and Analyses, p 859; Table and Efficacy, p 860

harms.label: Discontinuation because of an adverse event
harms.note: Adverse events leading to withdrawal; events were mostly gastrointestinal.

harms.label: Serious adverse event
harms.note: Urinary retention occurred in one placebo patient; urinary tract infection was reported among the serious events in the once-daily PPS group.

delivery.label: Oral treatment schedule
delivery.value: Pentosan polysulfate sodium 100 mg once daily or 100 mg three times daily, or matching placebo, for 24 weeks

delivery.label: Interim analysis and closure
delivery.value: Unblinded interim analysis after 6 years, with 369/645 (57.2%) of the target randomized, crossed the prespecified futility boundary (P ≥ 0.08 for three-times-daily PPS versus placebo) and led to early termination
delivery.locator: Full text, Data Analysis and Results, p 859

delivery.label: Study completion
delivery.locator: Full text, Figure 1, p 859; Patients, p 860

delivery.label: Analysis and missing data
delivery.value: ITT efficacy and safety set included 368 randomized patients who received at least one dose; the one patient assigned once-daily PPS who took no study drug was excluded; last observed ICSI data were carried forward for withdrawals before week 24
delivery.locator: Full text, Data Analysis and Efficacy End Points and Analyses, p 859; Figure 1, p 859

relations.note: Earlier placebo-controlled PPS studies reported symptom improvement; this later dose trial found no ICSI responder advantage.
